entries.title: We've launched Claude Fable 5.1
entries.summary: 发布Fable 5.1及Mythos 5.1，支持百万上下文与12.8万输出。

entries.title: Prompt cache reads on Claude Fable 5.1 and Claude Mythos 5.1 cost $0.25 USD per million tokens
entries.summary: 两款新模型的提示缓存读取价降至每百万Token 0.25美元。

entries.title: `tool_choice` types `any` and `tool` aren't supported
entries.summary: 两款新模型不支持tool_choice的any和tool类型。

entries.title: Thinking blocks produced by Claude Fable 5.1 and Claude Mythos 5.1 are preserved only for the model that produced them or a newer one
entries.summary: 新模型的思考块仅能由原模型或更新模型继续读取。

entries.title: Per-message effort changes are in beta
entries.summary: 消息级effort调整进入测试版，可保持提示缓存。

entries.title: Turn-scoped system messages are in beta
entries.summary: 仅当前轮次生效的系统消息功能进入测试版。

entries.title: `thinking.display` accepts a third value, `"updates"`, in beta
entries.summary: thinking.display新增updates测试值，可返回工具调用间进度。

entries.title: Text generated by Claude Fable 5.1 and Claude Mythos 5.1 carries Anthropic's text watermark
entries.summary: 两款新模型生成文本带水印，部分媒体文件带C2PA凭证。

entries.title: both models require 30-day data retention
entries.summary: 两款新模型要求保留数据30天，默认不支持零数据保留。

entries.title: `client.beta.files` and `client.beta.skills` no longer send the `files-api-2025-04-14` and `skills-2025-10-02` beta headers
entries.summary: 多语言SDK的文件与技能客户端停止自动发送旧测试标头。

entries.title: You can now create personal keys and service account keys in the Claude Console.
entries.summary: Claude Console现可创建个人密钥和服务账户密钥。

entries.title: The Compliance API session endpoints are out of beta for Cowork and Claude Code sessions.
entries.summary: Cowork与Claude Code会话的Compliance API端点正式发布。
